text: sed -n '1,50p' src/codegen_support/runtime/io/stream_type_name.rs: st WRAPPER_ID_DATA: u64 = 7; /// Wrapper id 12 is `zip://`, php's twelfth and last built-in wrapper. /// /// Measured on `php -n` 8.5.6: `stream_get_meta_data(fopen("zip://a.zip#f.txt","r"))` /// reports `wrapper_type` `"zip wrapper"` and `stream_type` `"zip"`. The id is the /// entry's position in the built-in wrapper-name table, so it is fixed by /// `STREAM_WRAPPERS` and by the `_meta_wrapper_*` list this file's sibling walks. pub(crate) const WRAPPER_ID_ZIP: u64 = 12; /// Emits `__rt_stream_type_name(handle) -> ptr, len`, or `0` when the stream has no recorded name. pub fn emit_stream_type_name(emitter: &mut Emitter) { match emitter.target.arch { Arch::AArch64 => emit_stream_type_name_aarch64(emitter), Arch::X86_64 => emit_stream_type_name_x86_64(emitter), } emit_stream_seek_unsupported(emitter); } /// Emits `__rt_stream_seek_unsupported(handle) -> 1` when the WRAPPER has no seek op.
